authorization: Mike approved use of the image generator on September 14, 2026.

prompts.core: Production sprites for the EXACT spacecraft reference, not a redesigned spacecraft. Deliver two rows of five sprites on a perfectly solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF background for chroma-key extraction; NO checkerboard, NO gradients or shadows on background, NO lettering. ROW ONE is the detached long thin pointed forward nose/spine of this spacecraft, with NO wings, NO engines. ROW TWO is its small detached central cockpit hull without the pointed nose, wings or engines. Five viewpoints per row, in this order: (1) top-down orthographic, forward direction UP, exactly as source; (2) FRONT END ON elevation, looking along the longitudinal axis so the long part becomes a SHORT HORIZONTAL CROSS SECTION, a flattened shallow trapezoid, NO visible pointed nose length; (3) LEFT SIDE elevation, nose toward LEFT, a long thin low horizontal profile with roof visible only as a thin edge; (4) BACK END ON elevation, another SHORT HORIZONTAL CROSS SECTION showing the rear connector socket, NOT a top view; (5) RIGHT SIDE elevation, nose toward RIGHT, a long thin low horizontal profile. ALL FIVE VIEWS AT SAME PHYSICAL SCALE, so frontal views are tiny in height. Top-down length must NEVER stay visible in end-on views. Clean crisp arcade pixel art matching the source, muted teal and gray-metal clusters, very dark navy outlines, cream highlights, no huge blue panels. Fixed evenly spaced cells, each part centered, generous magenta gutters. 5 columns x 2 rows only. No whole ships and no circular thruster exhausts on these two parts.
prompts.wings: Production component sprite sheet for the exact attached Furyship. Only its detached LEFT WING with its existing small mounted gun, and its matching RIGHT WING. Two rows, five columns, exactly TEN sprites. Row1 left swept wing; row2 right swept wing. Use the source's swept triangular metal panels and short forward gun, no new equipment. Columns in each row: TOP-DOWN nose north; FRONT END-ON elevation looking along gun, showing a thin horizontal wing cross-section and small gun muzzle, almost no wing top surface; LEFT SIDE elevation nose LEFT showing thin low wing profile and long narrow gun barrel; REAR END-ON elevation, thin horizontal wing cross-section with connector details and NO circular engine exhaust; RIGHT SIDE elevation nose RIGHT. End-on and profile views are much THINNER than the top-view wing: they are true orthographic elevations of one solid 3D piece, never top sprites rotated flat. Same scale across all cells, preserve wing mass and thinness. Dark fine pixel outlines, muted teal panels and gray metal, cream highlight clusters, detailed arcade pixel art matching reference. Plenty of empty margins per cell. Render on uniform pure magenta #FF00FF for chroma key; no checkerboard, no text, no grid, no scenery, no whole ship.
prompts.engines: A production pixel-art component sprite sheet: the twin cylindrical ENGINE PODS detached from the attached approved Furyship. Exactly 2 rows of 5 sprites, no whole ship. Row1 left engine, row2 right engine, matching mechanical mirrors. Columns TOP-DOWN (nose north, cyan nozzle south); FRONT END-ON (small dark intake/connector opening in metallic ring, no exhaust glow); LEFT SIDE elevation (thin elongated barrel nose left, cyan exhaust at right); REAR END-ON (circular cyan exhaust in thick concentric metal rings); RIGHT SIDE elevation (nose right, cyan exhaust at left). True orthographic views of same component at identical physical scale within row: end-on circles far shorter than long top and side views. Keep exact source engine family, segmented gray armor, muted teal detail, cream highlights, dark navy pixel outlines, bright cyan nozzle. Separate crisp sprites, uniform cells and generous gutters. Fine arcade pixel-art clusters, no smoothing, no text. TRANSPARENT RGBA background required, absolutely no checkerboard painted into image. If alpha unavailable use a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background without gradient; never black. No flames outside engines in this sheet.
prompts.assembly: Create one game-ready sprite sheet of a CYAN SPACECRAFT ASSEMBLY ENERGY effect in the pixel-art style and cyan palette of the referenced Furyship. NO ship or metal pieces in this sheet, only energy sprites. Exactly 8 square frames, arranged in 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, read left-to-right then next row. The animation is an oblique horizontal elliptical ring of electric cyan ribbons, open transparent center so a fighter plane remains visible. Sequence: 1 two small wisps; 2 wisps curl around into half-ring; 3 full thin orbit; 4 fast double orbit; 5 orbit brightens and tightens; 6 small inward sparks at four joints; 7 concise bright fusion ring burst; 8 outward fading fragments with center empty. Consistent center/pivot in every cell; no ring cropped; generous gutters. Sharp pixel-art clusters and stepped cyan/white highlights with deep teal edges, no photographic smoke. TRUE transparent RGBA backdrop, no painted checkerboard, no labels, no grids, no backgrounds. Separate sprites suitable for compositing around a 128px top-down fighter. Glow restrained so the ship remains legible.
prompts.veil: Pixel-art sky-to-space transition veil sprite sheet for a vertical arcade shooter. Exactly EIGHT frames in a 4-column x 2-row regular grid. Each frame is one complete vertical rectangular effect panel, same dimensions and center. All eight contained with very generous clean gutters, do not let light spill into adjacent frames. Read left-to-right then next row. No spacecraft, no background scene. Sequence: frame1 sparse cyan speed filaments along left/right outer edges, center empty; frame2 filaments curve inward like an energy curtain; frame3 cyan arcs begin closing; frame4 a bright blue-cyan curtain nearly closes; frame5 a dense icy cyan/white ENERGY FLASH covering the frame center to hide a background swap; frame6 energy curtain opens into separated side ribbons; frame7 side streaks recede; frame8 faint isolated side sparks and fully empty center. This is one short transition that goes transparent to covered to transparent. Sharp stepped cyan/teal/white pixel clusters matching detailed retro metallic shoot-em-up art, not photographic or soft smoke. TRUE RGBA transparent canvas, no checkerboard, no labels or grid lines, no scenery, absolutely no solid black baked background. Deliver large sprite sheet.
prompts.speed: Production 8-frame pixel-art speed wake animation for an arcade spaceship game. 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows, eight isolated sprite cells, generous gutters. Each frame depicts several thin cyan-white VERTICAL speed streaks streaming DOWNWARD around an EMPTY central flight corridor. Same shared center and scale; loop frames vary the streak lengths and positions subtly so scrolling feels extremely fast. No ship, no scenery, no text, no painted checkerboard. Crisp narrow pixel clusters, restrained teal outline, bright white cores. Black is used ONLY as the exactly uniform #000000 additive-compositing matte; no gradients, no fog, no haze, no glow covering empty center or gutters. Effects should be usable engine-wide for boosts, charge dashes, space flight and transitions. Each of the eight isolated frames must fit entirely inside its cell; all gutter pixels and center corridor exactly black. One consistent animation sprite sheet.
prompts.thrusters: Production pixel-art twin spaceship THRUSTER EXHAUST animation, matching cyan engine glow of attached Furyship. Only exhaust effects, NO ship or engine metal. Exactly EIGHT frames arranged 4 columns by 2 rows, consistent square cells and wide empty gutters. Each cell has TWO identical cyan plumes, parallel and vertical, mouth positions fixed at 40% and 60% of cell width and 25% of cell height, flames extending DOWNWARD. Animation sequence: tiny ignition sparks; short ignition tongues; medium flame; long hot thrust; long thrust pulse A; long thrust pulse B; medium taper; short taper. Fixed mouths in all eight cells, change only plume length and turbulence. Bright white inner core, turquoise/cyan middle, dark teal pixel edges, angular clustered pixels, no orange or purple. Transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard artwork, no fog or glow across cell background, no text/grid. Plumes fit fully within each cell, same physical scale and center across strip. Detail readable at small arcade game size.
prompts.roll: Create an EIGHT frame true 3D BARREL ROLL sprite sheet of the EXACT attached approved Furyship in crisp detailed arcade pixel art. 4 columns by 2 rows. Each cell same square canvas, same ship physical scale, same center pivot, nose stays pointing NORTH/up in ALL cells. Roll around the longitudinal nose-to-tail axis, NOT rotate in the image plane. Frames in reading order: 0 degrees top-down exact approved pose; 45 degrees right bank foreshortened; 90 degrees narrow edge-on right side with wings nearly overlapping; 135 degrees underside bank; 180 degrees full underside with same sharp nose, twin engine pods and wings, no cockpit visible underneath; 225 degrees underside other bank; 270 degrees narrow edge-on opposite side; 315 degrees returning left bank. Next frame would return to the reference top view. Preserve EXACT narrow pointed nose and silhouette of the source, muted teal-gray armor, tiny cream highlights, cyan twin exhausts. Do not redesign proportions, add guns, add wings or change colors. Consistent length across all eight poses; width changes only due to actual foreshortening. Generous transparent margins, no clipped sprites, no exhaust flames. Transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard artwork, no text or grid, no backgrounds.
